content.short: Oregon Blockchain aims to foster innovation and education around blockchain technology in Oregon.
content.description: Oregon Blockchain is a community-led group of University of Oregon students dedicated to advancing blockchain technology across Oregon. The chapter builds momentum for adoption and innovation by organizing events, curating educational resources, and facilitating collaboration among local businesses, developers, and enthusiasts. Through outreach and hands-on learning, the organization aims to raise awareness, share knowledge, and create opportunities for students and the broader community to engage with blockchain technology and its potential.
